mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 77 degrees under partly cloudy skies at City Hall, and a New Moon, though we do have an elevated air quality index of 61 today.

In city news, road construction on Highway M begins on August 18, which will shift traffic into the westbound lanes for the first phase of utility work. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review site plans for 201 South Main Street and the Sub-Zero development during their September 8 meeting.

There is plenty to do, including Hop Haus Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia nights at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the weekly report, on Wednesday, August 5, police officers responded to a residence on Whalen Road to locate a man with a probation warrant, who eventually turned himself in after attempting to flee.
Culver's is serving up their delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch today and will remain open until 10 PM. Make sure to stop by soon to grab a scoop before they close for the night.
